title: EU MIR 7.3.1, XSD build SB-11252 (10 Jun 2026)
plain: The Commission's MIR 7.3.1 schemas (one per report type) MDARIX builds and checks the EU MIR XML against, with the help text, the changelog and the PDF form (reference only), each pinned by SHA-256 in the manifest. Picked by the day the report is sent for approval; the XML is frozen at approval.

change.reason: The edition MDARIX holds, from the start (B8-D8). A newer build on the Commission's page is a new version.

review.note: Starter, for your consultant to confirm.

approval.note: B8 plan approved 11 Nov 2026 (B8-D8, D16): form editions pinned from the start; files downloaded from the Commission's page with the owner's OK (11 Nov 2026).
